meta.title: Finance / Tax / MDM Review: MDM cannot edit Account Group/PAN
gaps: Sign in as a Finance Controller on the specified Enterprise tenant and open Finance / Tax / MDM Review.
Set up the MDM review situation and verify that Account Group and PAN cannot be edited while setting the TDS code and rate without changing other fields.
Compare the observed behavior with the workbook note and determine whether FEAT-VM-023 should be raised.
